bāḷha.p: [Baha+ta] (na) Google Translate ဘ ဟု + လာ + န. ကစ် စည်း. 589. Ru. 621. မောဂ်၊ 7. 223. ဒါန်၊ ထီ. 4 1.] (1) Extreme; Intense Extremely severe. (Ti) (2) Extremely severe.

B:
bāḷha：bāḷha（na）
ဗာဠှ（န）
[baha+ta．bahu+lā+ṇa．ka．589．rū．621．，7．223．，ṭī．41．]
[ဗဟ+တ။ ဗဟု+လာ+ဏ။ ကစ္စည်း။ ၅၈၉။ ရူ။ ၆၂၁။ မောဂ်၊ ၇။ ၂၂၃။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၄၁။]
P: Bāḷha，（adj．） [Vedic bāḍha，orig．pp．of bahati2] strong; only as adv．°ṁ and °-，viz．-- 1．bāḷhaṁ strongly，very much，excessively，too much，to satiety J．II，293; VI，291 （i．e．too often，C．punappunaṁ）; Miln．407; PvA．274．Comparative bāḷhataraṁ in a higher degree，even more，too much Vin．II，270，276; Miln．125．-- 2．（°-） in bāḷha-gilāna very ill，grievously sick D．I，72; A．II，144; S．V，303; DA．I，212．（Page 486）
R:
bāḷha：ဗာဠှ （တိ） （တီ-ကိတ်） （√ဗဟ်+တ）
ပြင်းထန်သည်။ မြဲမြံသည်။
DOP: bāḷha mfn. [ S. bāḍha, bāḷha], strong; severe; Abh 41; D II 99, 4 (bhagavato … kharo ābādho uppajji ~ā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā; Sv 546, 32 : ~ā ti balavatiyo); M II 193, 4 (~ā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti); A III 252, 6 (~aṃ vā rogātaṅkaṃ phusati); Th 753 (passa orasikaṃ ~aṃ bhetvāna yadi tiṭṭhati, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se bālaṃ; Th-a III 29, 17 : ~aṃ balavataraṃ bhetvāna hadayaṃ vinivijjhitvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~aṃ balavantaṃ); — bāḷhaṃ, adv. , strongly, very much; so much; Th 924 (na ~aṃ ussukā āsuṃ); 982 (allaṃ sukkhaṃ ca bhuñjanto na ~aṃ suhito siyā); Thī 313 (kena vaṇṇena na ~aṃ paritappasi); Ja II 437, 14* (rogena ~aṃ dukkhitassa); VI 81, 10* (mā ~aṃ paridevesi); 295, 18* (na ~aṃ itthiṃ gaccheyya; 295, 24´ : punappunaṃ gaccheyya); 555, 16* (tadāyaṃ asito dhāto na ~aṃ tārayeyya no); Ap 339, 23 (ācārapaṭipatti te ~aṃ kho mama ruccati); — °- tara , mfn. , stronger; ~aṃ, adv. even more; Vin I 168, 20 (~aṃ savarabhayaṃ ahosi); 192, 3 (aññatarassa bhikkhuno yānugghātena ~aṃ aphāsu ahosi); II 270, 7 (bhikkhūnaṃ āmisaṃ ussannaṃ hoti … ~aṃ ussannaṃ hoti); Mil 125, 23 (~aṃ upagato si mama visayaṃ); — abāḷhaṃ at D III 174, 8* and Sv 939, 10 is prob. wr for bāḷhaṃ, see K.R. Norman 1992a, pp. 106–7; — atibāḷhaṃ , very strongly; too much; D I 92, 6 (~aṃ kho ayaṃ Ambaṭṭho māṇavo Sakkesu ibbhavādena nimmadeti); II 231, 10 (mā kho tvaṃ deva … ~aṃ paridevesi); M I 253, 33 (~aṃ kho ayaṃ yakkho pamatto viharati); Vibh 388, 13 (kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto ~aṃ mayi vyāvaṭā; Vibh-a 511, 27 : ~an ti atidaḷhaṃ atippamāṇaṃ); Mil 279, 17 (kiṃkāraṇā Vessantaraṃ dānapatiṃ ~aṃ paripātesi); — subāḷhaṃ , adv. , very strongly, very much; Ja V 117, 5* .

R:
bāḷhaṃ：ဗာဠှံ （နိ）
အသည်းအထန်။ ပြင်းစွာ။ လွန်စွာ။

a: ဗာဠှဒုဗ္ဗလ(တိ)

အလွန်အကဲ-အပြင်းအထန်-လွန်ကဲပြင်းထန်စွာ-မကျန်းမာသော၊ သူ။
